external_desc: Multiple services were experiencing issues in the europe-west2 region.

updates.text:
## Incident Report
### **Summary**
On Monday, 19 Oct 2026 (Tuesday, 20 Oct BST), a data center facility that hosts europe-west2-b, experienced an external electrical power disruption. This resulted in service unavailability for workloads located in this zone. As traffic was redirected to alternative cloud regions or unaffected zones within europe-west2 cloud region, these workloads experienced transient latency and elevated errors affecting services across europe-west2. 
The primary impact was mitigated after 6 hours 8 minutes.
